source: GGD 'GM Mapping' preset (GGD support docs; Munro Audio GGD MIDI Maps, https://www.munro-audio.com/midimaps)
notes: GGD ships a 'GM Mapping' preset (kick 36 / snare 38 are reliable), but tom and cymbal assignments vary per library title and the Groove Player uses a different internal map. Verify toms/cymbals in the library's Mapping tab and adjust if needed.
